comment: Generated by tools/models/convert.ps1 (F2) from the upstream 4.8 @ 9e40a757 (LGPL-2.1-or-later code). Armor bones carry the player's bone names, so the attachable follows the wearer.
notes: TravellersArmorItem.ArmorRender hides every part (skipDraw) and shows the vest (TRAVELLERS_HAS_CHESTPLATE), gloves (TRAVELLERS_HAS_GLOVES), belt (TRAVELLERS_HAS_BELT) and wings (TRAVELLERS_HAS_WINGS) by data component; a vest merged with gloves or wings merged with a belt draws both geometries. The wings animate in TravellersWingsModel.setupModelAnimations (WingState).
